_doc: devx parse table for decide2 (ids r_f7x2_* from devx round 2, r_f7x3_* from devx round 3). The r_f7x2_* LFs were authored by the round-3 arbiter from yn2b/f7_devx_blind_packet.jsonl ONLY (id, ladder_id, orig, qtype, state, instructions, card, options); no devx gold, sidecar, relation file, builder or audit file was opened before that table was written and hashed. Per ladder: atoms (how label / item atoms are read from the human label(s) of meta.orig) and facts (bool, quote from the state). Per row: the LF of 'yes' (yes/no rows) or CHOICE(select, [option LFs]). Ops: NOT, AND, OR, ANY, NONE, ALL, ATLEAST k, ATMOST k, EXACTLY k, L (label), I (batch item), F (fact). AMBIG(note, A, B) holds two readings of one construction and is refused when they differ: every devx exceptive (r_f7x2_14a_4 option 1, r_f7x3_17*_1, r_f7x2_17a_4 option 4; arbiter A3). The round-3 AMBIG wrappers were added after the golds were seen (disclosed in yn2b/F7_OBJECTIONS.md, arbiter round 3); every other r_f7x2_* LF is unchanged from the version hashed before any gold was opened (sha256 407c27f1...). The 4 r_f7x3_* LFs were written by the round-4 arbiter from the blind packet text only, before any decide2 or precheck run on them (yn2b/F7_OBJECTIONS.md, arbiter round 4). text_sha256: per row, the sha256 of json.dumps([state, instructions, card, options], ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True) of the text the LF was written from; decide2 refuses a devx row whose text differs.
